# Site walks

Use this skill for factory investigation and capture workflows. A site walk is
not a generic form: it is a structured investigation of areas, processes,
people, systems, equipment, data, observations, evidence, questions, and
follow-up actions.

Optimise for fast capture, clear site/area/process context, minimal friction,
source classification, assurance, provenance, and review state. Keep the
current `SiteWalk`, `Observation`, `Evidence`, and `ActionItem` relationships
intact. Design data so future mobile and offline capture can be added without
changing the meaning of records.

AI may transcribe, structure notes, suggest categories, identify missing
information, or generate follow-up questions. It must not turn notes into
verified facts automatically; preserve origin, assurance, AI status, and
human review.
